full.description: This is a micrograph of a liver biopsy sample showing a prominent portal tract infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, and eosinophils. Hepatocytes are visible at the bottom of the field adjacent to the inflamed tract. The histological findings are characteristic of mild-to-moderate acute cellular rejection in a liver allograft.
